threads.body:
@copilot Please make `convertMessage` and `convertMessageData` return `@Nullable Value<?>`, returning `null` when the top-level body map has no fields (`return body.isEmpty() ? null : Value.of(body);`). Replace this comparison with `if (body != null)` and keep `event.emit()` unconditional.

`Value.empty()` is an explicit empty value, not an unset body, and the SDK stores it as supplied. Keep the guard instead of passing `null` to `setBody`, since the API does not promise null support. Update affected callers and tests to preserve missing bodies for empty messages and populated bodies for content or metadata.

replies.body: Addressed in 06329a6c. Both converters now return `@Nullable Value<?>`, using `null` for an empty top-level map. All affected callers guard `setBody` and emit unconditionally. Bedrock library/javaagent tests passed (61 passed, 2 skipped), including empty messages and retained tool metadata; formatting passed.

+- GenAI message events from AWS Bedrock Runtime and OpenAI leave the body unset when no fields
